text:
Anna: Quick design sync: I'm iterating on a 'compact stack peek' inside Request Drilldown. goal: show 1-2 frames inline and let users expand without leaving the row.
Ben: Love the density idea. question: how do we surface correlation ids and copies in this tighter UI?
Anna: planned: tiny id pill truncated with a visible "Reveal" button. Copy action next to it.
Camille: prefer a button labeled "Reveal full ID" for clarity. hover-only tooltips fail for keyboard + SRs.
Ben: Agree. Also please ensure copied value is full id, not truncated view.
Anna: yep, copy will read from data attribute. will add aria-live confirmation.
Camille: a11y nit: color contrast for the pill text is borderline. we need 4.5:1.
Anna: noted, will update tokens. Also thinking of a little microcopy under stack peek: "Showing top frame — press Enter to open full trace."
Ben: For exports: we should show a single primary action "Download snapshot" and surface format choice in a secondary menu. default to JSON for small result sets.
DevBot: deploy #frontend-3921 succeeded, header add-download-filename present on staging.
Anna: thanks. I'll push an updated Figma and a short keyboard walkthrough doc. reconvene tomorrow to validate SR narration and focus order.
